verdict.rationale: Reaching an assistant through third-party messengers is a fair question for a self-hosted AI chat platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage integrations. The closest items are internal Channels, a PWA, API keys, an OpenAI-compatible gateway, and personal webhooks, and none of these is a messenger surface. Users would have to build their own bridge.
